title: THE SECRET OF MONKEY ISLAND
subtitle: Lucasfilm Games, 1990 · the EGA demo, on ScummVM 0.10.0 (2007), thirteen engines in one build
argsHint: -p<dir> where the game is, then its id (0.10.0's: monkey, monkey2, atlantis, tentacle, samnmax, queen...; it upgrades 0.6.1's monkeyEGA and the like). Other switches: -g<scaler> (1x, 2x, 3x, 2xsai, super2xsai, supereagle, advmame2x, advmame3x, hq2x, hq3x, tv2x, dotmatrix), -f full screen, -m<volume> music, -s<volume> effects, -n no subtitles, -z the games each engine knows.
fpsNote: A FALLBACK cap only: the engine paces itself on the SDL clock.

needsData.hint: monkey1-ega-demo/ from monkey1-dos-ega-demo-en.zip, the demo the ScummVM project distributes

controls: a verb at the bottom, then what it acts on
_why: The release three years after the 0.6.1 build beside it: 535 units, thirteen engines, the C++ of virtual bases, member templates and a String that points into itself. Held to a native g++ build of 0.10.0 frame by frame with a scripted player (gate-scummvm010).
